text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"three body paragraphs with intro and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It presents a clearer essay structure with an introduction, developed body paragraphs, and a concluding wrap-up."},{"evidence":"“There is no true evidence of a car being completely efficient on its own” followed by article quote and explanation","quality":"development","description":"It develops claims with more explanation and more sustained reasoning rather than just stating opinions."},{"evidence":"“who would be the one to blame for it?” and “who should cover the expenses for it”","quality":"argumentation","description":"It offers a more fully worked-out line of reasoning about liability and consequences instead of a brief unsupported objection."},{"evidence":"“As stated in the article…” and quoted details about sensors, human skills, and traffic laws","quality":"use of evidence","description":"It draws on multiple specific details from the source text to support its position."},{"evidence":"“driverless cars in our world today would not be beneficial because…”","quality":"clarity of claim","description":"It states a consistent position and returns to it clearly throughout the essay."}]}
